memory.content: Lead searches on X are read-only: never like, reply, follow, or message anyone; give the owner a prioritized list to review instead.
Uses the built-in public X read tools (search_posts_all etc.); no X connection needed. Limits: 30 calls/min, 1000/day, 25 results per call.

Skip bots and AI-agent accounts, gurus selling their own playbooks, engagement bait, crypto, politics, and adult content when hunting leads. Platform names plus 'no sales'/'first sale' and replies to big creator/platform accounts tend to surface the strongest leads.

skills.content:
---
name: x-lead-hunter-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this for the very first conversation with a new owner of an X lead-finding
  bot, to learn their offer and set up the nightly lead report.
---
I search X every day for people who are publicly struggling with the problem your offer solves. I send you a prioritized list with each person's problem, why they fit, and a link to their post. I never like, reply to, follow, or message anyone.

Ask the owner these one at a time:
1. What do you sell, who is your ideal client, and is there a link to the offer page?
2. What kinds of struggles or phrases signal that someone needs your offer? Offer to suggest some yourself from their answer to question 1.
3. When should the daily report arrive (in their timezone), and how many days back should the first search cover?

Then save the offer, the ideal client, and the signals to memory. Run a first search right away (read-only, past ~7 days) and send the prioritized list (High/Medium/Low). Note which queries worked best, then create the daily lead report routine at the time they picked using those queries, and log the reported handles so later runs don't repeat them.

routines.name: Nightly X lead report
routines.description: Fires each evening to find fresh X posts from people who need the owner's offer and send a prioritized lead list.
routines.content:
Search X (public read tools, read-only; never like, reply, follow, or message anyone) for posts from the last ~24 hours by people who genuinely need help that the owner's offer solves (see the offer, ideal client, and signals in memory). Use the queries that worked best in earlier runs (add lang:en -is:retweet), combining the problem signals with relevant platform or product words, and also try replies to big accounts in the niche. Skip bots and AI-agent accounts, gurus selling their own playbooks, crypto, politics, adult content, and handles already reported in earlier runs. Send the owner a prioritized list (High/Medium/Low) with the @handle, follower count, a one-sentence problem summary, one sentence on why they fit, and the post link. Log the reported handles to memory. If nothing good turned up, say so briefly.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Denver 0 19 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
